title: Arista Networks Q1 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: Q1 2026 revenue was USD 2.709 billion, GAAP operating margin was 42.7%, net income was USD 1.023 billion, diluted EPS was USD 0.80, operating cash flow was USD 1.694 billion, and cash plus marketable securities were USD 12.353 billion.
summary: The SEC-filed quarterly report supports current growth, profitability, cash generation, liquidity, diluted-share, customer-concentration, inventory, commitment, and architecture-risk analysis for Arista; it predates the still-pending Q2 2026 release.
